name: ogds-ai-components
description: Open Government Design System (ogds-elements) registry for AI coding agents. Self-contained static tiles flattened from the ogds-elements web components, with adaptation, coordination, and compliance metadata.

designSystem.name: Open Government Design System (ogds-elements)
designSystem.notes: ogds-elements is a Lit web-component implementation of USWDS 3.x patterns, styled with @ogds/tokens (USWDS-derived token ramps). Tiles are the flattened rendered DOM of each component (shadow-DOM content with story slot content); the canonical consumption path is the web component itself, named per tile in ogdsElement. Ground truth: installed @ogds/elements@1.0.0-beta.2. Styling is verified against the package's stylesheets via tools/build-ground-truth.mjs — a mechanical :host/:host([attr])/::slotted/::part transform whose outputs (infinite/ground-truth/*.css) carry identical class names; markup is verified against the components' render() templates.

staticView.note: Tiles inline their own component's derived CSS (token subset + transformed component styles), so they render self-contained. The full generated sheets are used for resolved views and the class ground-truth check.
